description: Election Commission - Mr. Mulgama Mudalihamige Ravindra Saman Kawirathna of the Balangoda Urban Council Vacated His Office of Members of that Urban Council.
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Balangoda Urban Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a declaration made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the status of an elected official, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
